description: Secrets Manager Secret Not Accessed in 90 Days
rationale: The secret was not retrieved in this Region for more than 90 days (or was never retrieved and is older than 90 days), so it is likely an orphaned credential that can still be used if leaked. LastAccessedDate is day-granular; a missing creation date or undescribed secret is UNKNOWN.
remediation: Confirm with the owner whether the secret is still needed; delete it (with a recovery window) or revoke the credential it holds.
